acceptanceCriteria: corvint-update check --allow-network --component core completes with a release relation (installed vs available) on the reporter host, or the observation bound is configurable or robust to slow first launch/loaded hosts while still failing closed on genuinely unobservable snapshots.
A regression test covers a version smoke whose descendant snapshot exceeds the old bound but completes within the new/configured bound.
body: SUSPECTED defect (not confirmed; looks like a timing bound, not a version mismatch). Observed 2026-10-17, macOS Darwin 25.6.0. Command: corvint-update check --allow-network --component core. Output: {"component":"core","freshness":"UNKNOWN","action":"check",...,"publisherIdentity":"NOT_VERIFIED"} then: version smoke failed: descendant snapshots were unavailable for 6.079s, beyond the 5s observation bound. Installed core: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 615). The same check with --component tasks worked (installed build 615, available tasks-dev-20260929.2 build 202, relation LOCAL_NEWER, apply refused as downgrade). Expected: core check reports installed vs available release and relation. Actual: freshness UNKNOWN because the installed-binary version smoke exceeded its 5s observation bound (possibly slow first launch or host load). Related, distinct: V1-1368 (completed; 1s descendantSnapshotTimeout failed on loaded host, passed on retry) and V1-0568 (open; descendant snapshot unavailable in desktop sandbox). Not yet checked: whether a retry passes.
title: corvint-update check --component core: version smoke fails with descendant snapshots unavailable 6.079s beyond the 5s observation bound (suspected defect)
